stem.en: Kabir attacks. Pick his best card.

text.en: "The boiled seed has the same grips in the same amounts. If a grip were the difference, it would be gone from the boiled one."
"The seed has hydrogen bonds and the oil does not. Hydrogen bonds are life."

feedback.en: The water in your glass has hydrogen bonds and is not alive. And the boiled seed has as many as the live one.

text.en: "The seed has ions and the oil has none. Ions are the spark."

feedback.en: Salt water is full of ions. The boiled seed has the same ions as the live seed.

image.alt: A boy playing his best card in a duel over a notebook page showing the flame-and-seed bonding ledger, a salt cube and an oil dish on the table.
